title: Do not record CRM Pulse activity while an admin is impersonating
recorded_defect: Owner decision 2026-09-17: activity while an admin is impersonating someone must not be recorded, the same as employee preview (b9b780d). Today templates/base.html turns the collector on for every authenticated app shell except employee preview (data-crm-telemetry is 'on' when app_shell_visible and not employee_preview), and blueprints/crm_pulse.py ingest_event stores events for current_user, which during impersonation is the impersonated user (blueprints/auth.py logs in the target and sets session['impersonator_id']). So an admin's clicks, visits and active time are credited to the person being impersonated.
objective:
CRM Pulse must not record any activity while an admin is impersonating another user, exactly as it already records nothing during employee preview. A session is impersonating when session.get('impersonator_id') is not None (see blueprints/auth.py and the existing checks in blueprints/api.py).

Make two changes, and nothing else:
1. templates/base.html: the body attribute data-crm-telemetry must be 'off' while impersonating, in addition to the existing employee-preview condition. Keep every other attribute and the existing literal text data-crm-telemetry-endpoint="/api/owner-pulse/events" and data-crm-page-key="{{ request.endpoint or '' }}" unchanged; tests assert them. Do not change the script tags.
2. blueprints/crm_pulse.py ingest_event: while impersonating, store nothing and answer 202 with JSON {"recorded": false, "eventCount": 0}, without validating or reading the payload. This protects against an older cached collector that still sends events. Keep the route, methods, decorators and every other response unchanged; a normal session must behave exactly as before.

Do not change services/crm_pulse.py, main.py, blueprints/auth.py, models, migrations or any other file. Do not change how users.last_activity is updated.

Write tests/test_crm_pulse_impersonation.py (pytest, using the fixtures in tests/conftest.py, as tests/test_crm_pulse.py and tests/test_gallery_sources_grant_workspace.py do; set session['_user_id'] to the impersonated user and session['impersonator_id'] to the admin through client.session_transaction). It must show:
(a) a valid events batch posted by an impersonating session (with a same-origin Referer, e.g. http://localhost/accounts, and pageKey employees.accounts) returns 202 with recorded false and stores no CRMPulseEvent rows for either user;
(b) the same batch posted by a normal, non-impersonating session of the same target user stores the events and returns 201;
(c) a rendered authenticated page (for example GET /accounts or /dashboard, whichever returns 200 for that user) contains data-crm-telemetry="off" while impersonating and data-crm-telemetry="on" without impersonation.
You cannot run pytest yourself; the harness runs it.
verification_note: Runs on the scratch clone's branch codex/crm-pulse-batch-integrity-20260917 (514b6f1). Launcher sets CRM_TEST_DB_PATH outside the worktree and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Known residual, out of scope by design: impersonation still refreshes the target's users.last_activity (session idle timeout depends on it), so Pulse's session-based people list can still show the target as connected.
